bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -d "$P"
test -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
HEAD=$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)
BRANCH=$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)
DIRTY=$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
ACTIVE=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -c gaybbs || true)
IMG=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-19 || true)
printf 'GAYBBS_PREFLIGHT head=%s branch=%s dirty_paths=%s active_containers=%s image=%s\n' "$HEAD" "$BRANCH" "$DIRTY" "$ACTIVE" "$IMG"
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "GAYBBS_PREFLIGHT_20261113 head=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH dirty_paths=$DIRTY active_containers=$ACTIVE image=$IMG" >/dev/null || exit 71
echo GAYBBS_PREFLIGHT_RECORDED
